description:
Create a product so the storefront has real merchandise (grid-product / slider-product bindings need this).
Simple use: pass name + price (+ images, category_ids). One default variation with the price/stock is created for you.
Advanced use: pass attributes (e.g. Color/Size) + variations for a multi-SKU product.
Images must be HOSTED URLs — get them from search_images or upload_images first. The backend generates id, slug and publishes the product.

category_ids.description: Product category IDs to file the product under (from create_product_category / list_categories)

description.description: Full product description (HTML allowed) — binds to product::description on the detail page.

images.description: Hosted image URLs (search_images/upload_images). First image becomes the product thumbnail.

original_price.description: List/compare-at price for the simple single-variation case

price.description: Selling price (used when you don't pass variations). Required unless variations are given.

short_description.description: Short description / tagline (HTML allowed) — binds to product::short_description on cards + the detail page. Set this so cards aren't blank.

sku.description: SKU / custom_id for the simple case (auto-generated if omitted)

stock.description: Stock quantity for the simple single-variation case

variations.description: Explicit per-SKU variations. Omit to auto-build one from price/stock/sku.

custom_id.description: SKU for this variation (auto-generated if omitted)

fields.description: Attribute values for this variation, e.g. [{name:'Color',value:'Đen'},{name:'Size',value:'M'}]

images.description: Hosted image URLs for this variation

name: create_product
